name: study-kt-olmo2-1b-r16-b-mb2-20261008
purpose: Rank-16 variant of study-kt-olmo2-1b-r64-b-mb2-20261008 (GI III, 8 October; used only if the Qwen rank-16 test shows that rank matters): identical except model.lora.r 16 (was 64), model.lora.alpha 32 (was 128, so alpha/r stays 2) and 12,058,624 trainable LoRA values (one quarter of 48,234,496). Family probe olmo2-1b (brief multi-family-probe-engine-20261007): recipe B (study-kt-instruct-r64-b-20261007) unchanged except the model (allenai/OLMo-2-0425-1B-Instruct @ 48d788ec, Olmo2ForCausalLM, its end of turn, stops, pad and assistant header; 48,234,496 trainable LoRA values) and this memory candidate: micro-batch 2 x accumulation 64, gradient checkpointing off, sdpa attention for the policy only (the guard stays recipe B's), generation batch 32. The preflight takes the first passing candidate of the probe's ladder; the guard and every evaluation setting are recipe B's.

train.batching: consecutive examples of one epoch's order; an epoch's final optimizer step keeps its actual size; steps never cross epochs
train.loss: per-example mean NLL over response target tokens (response plus end-of-turn), averaged over the actual examples of each optimizer step
